name: Rapsy Restaurant
signature_dish: Kerala parotta with beef roast — plus the much-praised masala chai
why_it_matters: The most consistently recommended restaurant in Munnar town, Rapsy sits in the Main Bazaar and is the local-and-tourist favourite for Kerala parotta, biryani and home-style non-veg — its masala chai is repeatedly singled out as among the best in Kerala. A simple room where the food, not the ambience, is the draw.
insider_tip: Order the parotta with beef roast and finish with the masala chai. The kappa biryani (tapioca biryani) is a local specialty worth trying. Central in the Main Bazaar — easy to reach by auto from anywhere in town; expect a small wait at mealtimes.
signature_address: Rapsy Restaurant, Main Bazaar, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala 685612

name: Saravana Bhavan
signature_dish: Ghee roast masala dosa — South Indian vegetarian served on banana leaf
why_it_matters: A long-running pure-vegetarian restaurant in the Munnar market near the church, Saravana Bhavan is the town's go-to for authentic South Indian breakfast — dosas, idlis and vada served fresh and fast, often crowded with locals eating before work. It is the reliable veg anchor of Munnar town.
insider_tip: Best for an early breakfast — the rava onion dosa and ghee roast masala dosa with fresh vada are the picks; go before the tour buses arrive. Opens around 7.30am. Parking is tight in the market; walk in.
signature_address: Saravana Bhavan, Munnar Market, near church, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala 685612

name: Eastend Munnar Restaurant
area: Temple Road, near Munnar town centre
signature_dish: Kerala and North Indian dinner spread in a comfortable hotel restaurant
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant at Hotel Eastend, a few hundred metres from the centre of Munnar town, this is one of the area's most-recommended family restaurants for a comfortable sit-down dinner — a wide menu of Kerala and North Indian dishes in a warmer setting than the bazaar eateries.
insider_tip: A good choice for dinner when the bazaar places have closed — sit-down service, broad menu, family-friendly. Central enough to walk to from town-centre hotels; reserve on busy season weekends.
signature_address: Eastend Munnar Restaurant, Hotel Eastend, Temple Road, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala 685612

name: KTDC Tea County Restaurant
area: KTDC Tea County, near Munnar town
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine meals with valley views — County Cuisine restaurant of the KTDC property
why_it_matters: County Cuisine is the multi-cuisine restaurant at KTDC Tea County, the Kerala Tourism Development Corporation's hill-station property near Munnar town. KTDC restaurants are a verified state-run network across Kerala; this one is valued for a clean, safe, quality-controlled meal with sweeping views over the tea slopes, plus the adjoining High Life beer parlour.
insider_tip: Come for the view as much as the food — the restaurant overlooks the Munnar tea country. It is a KTDC government property, so reliable and clean if a bit pricier than town eateries. Near the town, an easy auto ride.
signature_address: KTDC Tea County Restaurant, KTDC Tea County, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala 685612

name: Tea Tales Cafe
signature_dish: Munnar tea and coffee with cafe fare — a cosy hideaway above the street
why_it_matters: A small, well-decorated cafe tucked above the street in Munnar town centre, Tea Tales is the town's most-recommended cosy coffee-and-tea stop — a quieter retreat from the busy bazaar, with a varied cafe menu and attentive service, well rated on Tripadvisor.
insider_tip: It is hidden up some steep steps and easy to miss — look up. Good for an afternoon Munnar tea and cake break between sightseeing; calmer than the street-level eateries.
signature_address: Tea Tales Cafe, Munnar town centre, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala 685612
